description: Arrêts de bus PMR is a dataset listed in Ville-d'avray open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Seine Ouest. Localisation des arrêts de bus accessibles aux personnes à mobilité réduite (PMR) sur Ville-d'Avray Retrouvez la carte des aménagements en faveur des personnes à mobilité réduite sur SoCarto le portail cartographique de GPSO. Coverage: Ville-d'Avray. The portal files it under Accessibilité, Transports, Déplacements, Mobilité. Its keywords are PMR, Ville d'Avray, Arrêts de bus. The portal shows 31 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-villedavray-fr-portal.
